description: An optional attribute in an exact type is an error
notes: The README lets attributes of object type expressions be marked optional without limiting that to type constraints (it does limit any), and TypeConstraint's documentation says a type constraint has the same structure as a type, adding only the keyword any. hashicorp/hcl's getType (ext/typeexpr/get_type.go) accepts optional only when it reads a type constraint, and reports it as an error in an exact type.
reference_error: Optional attribute modifier is only for type constraints
